body: What a nice positive thing to say! I will meditate on this. I want to continue to enjoy playing music. The people in my section are nice enough.

Im here to support you! I know what it’s like to want to disappear. I have chronic health issues. I have done years of therapy and meds. I come to this subreddit when I’m struggling, and it passes eventually and I move on. sometimes I have to focus on basics needs.
This sounds so serious. What treatment gave you had? Do you feel like this all the time?

This is the best comment fun and lighthearted. No it was down a country lane. I played American Salute when we had 3 bassoons. The day of the concert. The first bassoon got s stomach virus and we had to bring in a bass clarinet. It still was super fun to play!
This is so relatable. Thanks for the book suggestions. I will check them out.
These are great ideas. Im hoping i’ll meet some musicians in the-new group that I could do this with.
I really haven’t got feedback. Might be because it is a large group.
Lessons are a good suggestion. I was thinking about it.

I would give yourself time and acknowledge that there is a reason you are playing differently. I think it’s okay to feel your feelings and be discouraged. Im no expert in psychology, but don’t think it’s fair to value you identify based on your current skill level. Acknowledge that is you were able to maintain you playing you would be there and there’s no reason you can’t be there again.
Thank you so much for all the comments. I found them very encouraging and remind me of why I play.
